purpose: The Creative Brief of the first autonomous C2 run, as DATA. It carries Marketing facts and APPROVED text only: which approved text exists, what each approved claim is (its semantic role), and the public facts of the product. It carries no composition, no layout, no recipe, no font size, no colour choice, no background and no provider instruction: those are decided by Nordla's agents and rules at run time (see docs/architecture/creative-c2c-product-preserving-runtime.md).

approved_copy.note: an authorised HABB copy variant (a new governed decision); non-claim creative text

price.why: a price claim is the price text

promise.why: the approved visible speed claim is a supporting message, not a price and not the headline

public_facts.merchant: HABB, magasin de cadeaux personnalisés et d'impression UV à Namur (Belgique)

note: Everything in this file may be sent to a language model as is: it holds no merchant media and no personal data.
